Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest

Class ConfigGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.ConfigGameTestsLogic
public final class ConfigGameTestsLogic extends Object
Checks on the datapack-loaded ServerEyeConfigs (the shipped configs are loaded by the gametest server — the manual somegoogly-test-datapack is not mounted here), the reload listener's exact Minecraft-version selection, and the pure ServerConfig.percentFor(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation) resolution. Tests that mutate shared state (config values via their public set, the loaded eye configs via replaceAll) restore the originals in a finally so later tests aren't affected.

    • spawnAllDefaultsOff

      public static void spawnAllDefaultsOff(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      /sg spawnall terraforms and mass-spawns with no undo, so its server-config gate must ship opt-in. MineColonies and Create entities require spawn context this command does not provide, so those namespaces must ship excluded. The packet-handler refusal itself needs a live player and stays source-verified.

    • everyShippedConfigHasNonBlankAttachTokens

      public static void everyShippedConfigHasNonBlankAttachTokens(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Every head in every shipped config must carry a non-blank attach token. The attachPoint is required (no default), so a token that loads as null/empty means a corrupt data edit — this catches that across all 80+ files in one cheap headless check. It does not (and can't, on the dedicated server, where the client-only resolvers don't load) verify the token resolves to a real model part; that needs an in-client pass.
